name: side crunch v. 3
description: A side crunch, a second variation, aimed at the obliques. It shortens the side of the waist with a small controlled movement.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
